anime.name: Anime Style (Nhật Bản)
anime.description: Phong cách anime điện ảnh, màu tươi, nhân vật rõ nét
anime.prompt: anime style, vibrant colors, clean outlines, soft cel shading, detailed eyes, studio-quality anime frame, high-clarity character design

cartoon.name: Cartoon Style (Hoạt hình US)
cartoon.prompt: cartoon style, bold outlines, simplified shapes, expressive features, flat shading, smooth and colorful animation look

pixar.name: Pixar / Disney 3D
pixar.description: Hoạt hình 3D mềm mại, da sáng bóng
pixar.prompt: Pixar-style 3D character, soft lighting, smooth subsurface scattering, expressive face, highly detailed 3D render, cinematic depth of field

3d_realistic.name: 3D Realistic (CGI)
3d_realistic.prompt: realistic CGI character, high-detail 3D model, physically based rendering, sharp textures, soft global illumination, cinematic lighting

semi_realistic.name: Semi-Realistic (2.5D)
semi_realistic.description: Nửa hoạt hình nửa thật — rất hợp video kể chuyện
semi_realistic.prompt: semi-realistic illustration, soft shading, stylized proportions, smooth gradients, high readability, studio concept art look

hyper_realistic.name: Hyper Realistic (Chân thực 100%)
hyper_realistic.description: Dùng cho nội dung lịch sử, chân dung
hyper_realistic.prompt: hyper-realistic photography style, detailed skin texture, cinematic lighting, natural colors, ultra-high resolution, depth of field

comic.name: Comic / Western Comic
comic.prompt: comic book art style, bold ink lines, dynamic shading, halftone texture, dramatic action composition, vibrant colors

manga.name: Manga (Đen trắng)
manga.description: Dễ ổn định và thích hợp kể truyện
manga.prompt: manga style, black and white, fine line art, screentone shading, expressive eyes, high contrast panel-style illustration

low_poly.name: Low-Poly 3D
low_poly.description: Phong cách tối giản kiểu game indie
low_poly.prompt: low-poly 3D render, simplified geometric shapes, flat colors, soft lighting, clean polygons, stylized environment

flat.name: Flat Illustration 2D
flat.prompt: flat illustration style, bold shapes, minimal details, clean vector look, smooth gradients, modern color palette

claymation.name: Claymation / Stop Motion
claymation.description: Nhìn như mô hình đất sét
claymation.prompt: claymation style, soft clay textures, handcrafted look, small imperfections, studio lighting, stop-motion aesthetic

ghibli.name: Painting-like Animation (Ghibli Style)
ghibli.description: Phong cách anime đẹp – mềm – màu rất xịn
ghibli.prompt: Ghibli-inspired style, soft lighting, painterly textures, warm color palette, expressive characters, cinematic anime background

cinematic_hollywood.name: Cinematic Hollywood (Điện ảnh bom tấn)
cinematic_hollywood.description: Chân thực chuẩn điện ảnh, ánh sáng Rembrandt, camera anamorphic 8k
cinematic_hollywood.prompt: cinematic Hollywood movie still, 8k resolution, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, 35mm lens, depth of field, dramatic shadows, blockbuster film atmosphere, ultra high fidelity

cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk / Sci-Fi Neon
cyberpunk.description: Tương lai viễn tưởng, đèn neon rực rỡ, thành phố mưa đêm, Blade Runner
cyberpunk.prompt: cyberpunk futuristic sci-fi style, glowing neon lights, rain-slicked reflective surfaces, holographic displays, high-tech dark dystopian city, dramatic atmospheric lighting

wes_anderson.name: Wes Anderson Pastel Aesthetic
wes_anderson.description: Màu pastel độc đáo, bố cục đối xứng hoàn hảo, The Grand Budapest Hotel
wes_anderson.prompt: Wes Anderson visual aesthetic, pastel color palette, meticulous symmetrical framing, vintage whimsical composition, warm retro color grading, highly stylized storybook cinematic look

dark_fantasy.name: Dark Fantasy / Gothic Cinematic
dark_fantasy.description: U tối, huyền bí, phong cách Lord of the Rings / Game of Thrones
dark_fantasy.prompt: dark fantasy epic cinematic style, moody atmospheric fog, muted grim color tones, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, intricate armor and fabrics, mystical high fantasy realism

retro_vhs.name: Retro 80s/90s Vintage Film (VHS)
retro_vhs.description: Băng từ hoài niệm, màu phim nhựa cổ điển, vệt scanline thập niên 80-90
retro_vhs.prompt: 1980s vintage film aesthetic, retro VHS tape look, soft film grain, authentic analog colors, chromatic aberration, nostalgic warm tones, classic retro cinema

watercolor.name: Watercolor Storybook (Tranh truyện cổ tích)
watercolor.description: Tranh vẽ màu nước dịu dàng, nét cọ mềm mại, lý tưởng kể chuyện/bài học
watercolor.prompt: delicate watercolor children's storybook illustration, soft wet-on-wet paint washes, gentle pencil contours, pastel natural tones, whimsical storybook warmth, artistic paper texture

documentary.name: Documentary Film (National Geographic)
documentary.description: Phim tài liệu chân thực tự nhiên, ống kính tele chuyên nghiệp, sắc nét
documentary.prompt: National Geographic documentary cinematography, authentic natural colors, sharp telephoto lens focus, realistic ambient lighting, breathtaking real-world detail, 4k raw footage look

lego.name: Lego Brick Animation
lego.description: Mô hình Lego xếp hình chuyển động Stop-motion vui nhộn, sống động
lego.prompt: Lego brick animation style, detailed plastic toy bricks, glossy reflective studs, miniature stop-motion tilt-shift effect, charming plastic toy aesthetic
